notes: Variant WLC.JER.6.7.v001 is underdetermined over s003 and the base reading is what the projection carries; no textual decision is made here.
'before me continually is sickness' is read as a prepositional predicate, so 'is' sits on עַל־פָּנַי rather than on חֳלִי (rule 49); the competing reading would put the copula on the noun.

כְּ + infinitive הָקִיר is divided as rule 52 divides a preposition before an infinitive: 'As' to the preposition, 'casteth forth' to the infinitive, with the explicit subject בַּיִר keeping its own unit.
